note: Daily option-writing walls at the previous close, and whether their movement precedes anything. END-OF-DAY ONLY - this is not the live intraday indicator from the original guide, which needs a paid OI feed.

cautions.eod: One snapshot per day. Intraday wall movement is not available free.
cautions.all_expiries: Open interest is summed across expiries, so the wall is not the nearest-expiry chain.
cautions.not_a_signal: A historical tendency is not a prediction, and not a recommendation.
